items.title: Flood-displaced settlements at risk from “toxic liquor”
items.summary: Residents of Uttargaya Rural Municipality-1 in Rasuwa, displaced by the Bhotekoshi flood and living temporarily in Nuwakot, now face the added danger of “toxic” homemade liquor. Police have launched a crackdown after the sale and distribution of illicit liquor made from inedible ingredients increased in and around the displaced settlements. items.title: Nepal cannot leave children’s safety to chance when floods strike
items.summary: A photograph published by a national daily shows a student at Bageshwari Secondary School in Baireni, Dhading, searching through a mud-caked schoolbag. items.title: Bhotekoshi flood displaced 777 students. Nepal plans five-year school recovery
items.summary: Of the 57 educational institutions assessed in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, and Dhading districts, 28 were damaged and 15 were completely destroyed.
